response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer (14+ years, CS degree, strong polyglot background including C/C++, Java, C#, TypeScript, and high-throughput low-latency work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby). However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered specifically on growth and experimentation systems — A/B testing frameworks, feature flighting, telemetry and metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, and bias/rollout-risk management — and the resume shows no evidence of any of these. His trajectory is senior/staff IC in small-to-midsize product companies rather than architecting cross-org platforms at enterprise scale, and there is no demonstrated data/experimental-analysis aptitude or track record influencing multiple teams via shared measurement systems. Strong generalist, but a poor match for this specialized principal-level mandate.
strengths: 14+ years broad engineering experience with C/C++, Java, C#, JS/TS, and a CS degree
Proven high-scale, low-latency service work (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, open-source tooling, teaching and mentoring
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-platform experience
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/experimental analysis background
Scope and leadership level appear staff/senior IC rather than principal-level cross-org architecture

key_factors.factor: Deep, long-tenured engineering breadth and distributed-systems scale experience
